audit_items.proof_trace: FlashLoan<MarketType, CoinType> and its inner ReserveFlashLoan<MarketType, CoinType> both declare no abilities (no copy, drop, store), making them Move hot potatoes that the VM requires to be consumed in the same PTB by language semantics — no user bypass is possible. The sole destructuring site (market.move:836) inside repay_flash_loan enforces exact repayment via assert!(coin.value() == inner.amount() + fee), and fee > 0 is guaranteed at borrow time (market.move:814), so amount_repaid = principal + fee > principal satisfying the >= principal condition.
